doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Parenti's family, the Liberty Theater, and Giardina's Millenburg band
summary: Parenti describes his Italian shoemaker father and siblings, his popularity at the Liberty and triangle theaters, then moves to Millenburg and Ernest Giardina's ragtime band with Emile Christian.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
